sources.note: Owner research in issue #379 (patterns 2 and 3): most contracts can be cancelled by 30 November; after a higher bill the special right runs four weeks. No page was fetched for this file.

route: Compare on a comparison portal each autumn and finish the new contract there before the cancellation deadline; the new insurer handles the cancellation. After a higher bill the special right lets you leave within four weeks of it.
person_does: Open a comparison portal and enter the facts from the prepared page (no-claims class, mileage, car).
Choose the new contract, confirm it and sign on the portal or the insurer's page.
Send your assistant the new insurer's confirmation.
